newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - PaineWebber cuts Amerin.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - PaineWebber cuts Amerin.

text.p: -- PaineWebber cut its rating on Amerin Corp to attractive from buy based on the stock price, a PaineWebber source said.
-- Additional details were not immediately available.

-- PaineWebber analyst Gary Gordon said in a report that his 12-month target price on Amerin remains $30 a share, up 17 percent from the current trading price, but below the 20 percent that PaineWebber normally requires for a buy rating.
-- PaineWebber said it remains optimistic about Amerin's earnings per share growth.
-- It said it remains "generally bullish" on the long-term mortgage insurance industry. Risks include interest rates, weakness in the housing market, and changes in industry competition, it said.

-- Amerin has built an "interesting niche in the MI (mortgage insurance) business by offering a wholesale MI product. Its wholesale approach translates into lower operating expenses, which means a lower premium charged to its customers," PaineWebber said.
